hypothesis: Walker Lane GPS/geodetic shear-strain rate (geod_2ndinv) exceeds what the mapped Quaternary catalogue can kinematically explain in places (Bormann, Hammond & Kreemer 2016, Geology 44:535, 'missing shear' across the central Walker Lane). Where that strain forms an anisotropic (elongated, not blob-like) ridge AND instrumental seismicity (deq_n100a15 / ieq_n100a15) corroborates it, the catalogue-masked gap is a candidate unmapped structure.
mechanism: Structure-tensor coherence x log-gradient of geod_2ndinv (reusing gems57.strand_orientation.magnetic_geometry, originally built for TMI, applied here to a strain-rate scalar) distinguishes elongated tectonic strain ridges from isotropic non-tectonic blobs; deq_n100a15/ieq_n100a15 (never used in the shipped 9-plane gems57.geo.GEO_FEATURES block) add independent seismic corroboration. These 3 new planes are appended to the shared, pinned gems57 fault-zone-anatomy feature matrix and fit with the identical HistGradientBoostingClassifier recipe used by the template's shipped configuration.
named_non_fault_mimic: Fluid-production/injection-induced subsidence or inflation at producing or developed geothermal fields (e.g., Dixie Valley, Brady's, Desert Peak, Steamboat Springs) and groundwater-pumping cones can generate local geodetic strain-rate anomalies unrelated to tectonic faulting. The anisotropy/elongation gate is a partial defense (production bowls are typically isotropic, not lineated), but no well/production-siting layer could be ingested in this sandbox (OpenEI/NV production GIS hosts are outside the outbound allowlist), so this mimic is reported, not fully deconfounded, and is flagged for the next session.

detached_mode_primary.note: Detached mode (withheld components not touching any visible trace) is the closer analogue to a genuinely unmapped splay; the shipped production field is the stitched 4-fold OOF model from this mode.

leakage_canary.note: 'd' and/or 'd_perp' (distance/cross-strike offset to nearest VISIBLE fault, inherited base features present in every gems57 anatomy configuration, identical in both shipped_g and smsr_g) exceed the 0.90 discriminative-AUC bar in both arms (0.9245 all-mode, 0.9353 detached-mode). This is a known, previously-documented characteristic of this exact hide-and-recover design (gems57.fitting.canary docstring: 'd is expected to be highly discriminative... but it must not be near-perfect'); 0.92-0.94 is flagged but not near-perfect (>0.99). It affects the ABSOLUTE 0.32 HOLDOUT-DTI level in both arms equally and therefore does not bias the SMSR-vs-shipped DIFFERENTIAL result, but the absolute number should be treated with this caveat. None of the 3 new SMSR planes individually exceeds 0.90.
